  340|       |/// Compute the aggregate content hash for a PostgreSQL target table.
  341|       |#[cfg(feature = "postgres")]
  342|       |async fn compute_target_hash(
  343|       |    pg: &PgPool,
  344|       |    table: &str,
  345|       |    select_columns: &str,
  346|       |    chunk_size: usize,
  347|       |) -> Result<String> {
  348|       |    let count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {}", table))
  349|       |        .fetch_one(pg)
  350|       |        .await?;
  351|       |    let count = count as usize;
  352|       |    let mut hashes = Vec::new();
  353|       |    for offset in (0..count).step_by(chunk_size) {
  354|       |        let sql = format!(
  355|       |            "SELECT {} FROM {} LIMIT {} OFFSET {}",
  356|       |            select_columns, table, chunk_size, offset
  357|       |        );
  358|       |        let rows = sqlx::query(&sql).fetch_all(pg).await?;
  359|       |        for row in &rows {
  360|       |            let canonical = canonical_row(row, select_columns)?;
  361|       |            let hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(canonical.as_bytes()));
  362|       |            hashes.push(hash);
  363|       |        }
  364|       |    }
  365|       |    Ok(aggregate_hash(hashes))
  366|       |}

  524|       |#[cfg(feature = "postgres")]
  525|       |async fn migrate_table(
  526|       |    sqlite: &SqlitePool,
  527|       |    pg: &PgPool,
  528|       |    tm: &TableMigration<'_>,
  529|       |    apply: bool,
  530|       |    chunk_size: usize,
  531|       |    resume: bool,
  532|       |    source_count: usize,
  533|       |) -> Result<TableResult> {
  534|       |    let mut result = TableResult {
  535|       |        table: tm.name.to_string(),
  536|       |        source_count,
  537|       |        target_count: 0,
  538|       |        migrated_count: 0,
  539|       |        id_match: true,
  540|       |        count_match: true,
  541|       |        hash_match: true,
  542|       |        source_content_hash: None,
  543|       |        target_content_hash: None,
  544|       |        errors: Vec::new(),
  545|       |    };
  546|       |
  547|       |    if apply {
  548|       |        // Target-empty safety check (skipped when resuming)
  549|       |        if !resume && !is_target_empty(pg, tm.name).await? {
  550|       |            bail!(
  551|       |                "target table '{}' is not empty; P4.4 MVP requires an empty target",
  552|       |                tm.name
  553|       |            );
  554|       |        }
  555|       |
  556|       |        let sql = build_insert_sql(tm.insert_sql, tm.conflict_target, resume)?;
  557|       |        let mut source_ids = BTreeSet::new();
  558|       |        let mut source_hashes = Vec::new();
  559|       |
  560|       |        for offset in (0..source_count).step_by(chunk_size) {
  561|       |            let select_sql = format!(
  562|       |                "SELECT {} FROM {} LIMIT {} OFFSET {}",
  563|       |                tm.select_columns, tm.name, chunk_size, offset
  564|       |            );
  565|       |            let rows = sqlx::query(&select_sql).fetch_all(sqlite).await?;
  566|       |
  567|       |            if let Some(id_col) = tm.id_column {

  570|       |                        source_ids.insert(id);
  571|       |                    }
  572|       |                }
  573|       |            }
  574|       |
  575|       |            // Compute source content hashes for this chunk
  576|       |            for row in &rows {
  577|       |                match canonical_row(row, tm.select_columns) {
  578|       |                    Ok(canonical) => {
  579|       |                        let hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(canonical.as_bytes()));
  580|       |                        source_hashes.push(hash);
  581|       |                    }
  582|       |                    Err(e) => {
  583|       |                        result.errors.push(format!("canonicalization error: {}", e));
  584|       |                    }
  585|       |                }
  586|       |            }
  587|       |
  588|       |            // Attempt chunk-wide transaction for efficiency
  589|       |            let mut txn = pg.begin().await?;
  590|       |            let mut chunk_ok = true;
  591|       |            let mut chunk_errors = Vec::new();
  592|       |            for row in &rows {
  593|       |                let mut query = sqlx::query(&sql);
  594|       |                for i in 0..tm.param_count {
  595|       |                    let col_name = tm.select_columns.split(',').nth(i).map(|s| s.trim());
  596|       |                    let col_name = match col_name {
  597|       |                        Some(c) => c,
  598|       |                        None => {
  599|       |                            chunk_errors
  600|       |                                .push(format!("column mismatch at parameter index {}", i + 1));
  601|       |                            chunk_ok = false;
  602|       |                            continue;
  603|       |                        }
  604|       |                    };
  605|       |                    if col_name == "auto_commit" || col_name == "active" {
  606|       |                        match row.try_get::<Option<i64>, _>(col_name)? {
  607|       |                            Some(v) => query = query.bind(v != 0),
  608|       |                            None => query = query.bind(None::<bool>),
  609|       |                        }
  610|       |                    } else if col_name == "step_index" || col_name == "entry_id" {
  611|       |                        match row.try_get::<Option<i64>, _>(col_name)? {
  612|       |                            Some(v) => query = query.bind(v),
  613|       |                            None => query = query.bind(None::<i64>),
  614|       |                        }
  615|       |                    } else {
  616|       |                        match row.try_get::<Option<String>, _>(col_name)? {
  617|       |                            Some(v) => query = query.bind(v),
  618|       |                            None => query = query.bind(None::<String>),
  619|       |                        }
  620|       |                    }
  621|       |                }
  622|       |                if let Err(e) = query.execute(&mut *txn).await {
  623|       |                    chunk_errors.push(format!("insert error: {}", e));
  624|       |                    chunk_ok = false;
  625|       |                }
  626|       |            }
  627|       |
  628|       |            if chunk_ok {
  629|       |                txn.commit().await?;
  630|       |                result.migrated_count += rows.len();
  631|       |            } else {
  632|       |                txn.rollback().await?;
  633|       |                // Fallback to row-by-row to preserve per-row error semantics
  634|       |                for row in &rows {
  635|       |                    let mut query = sqlx::query(&sql);
  636|       |                    for i in 0..tm.param_count {
  637|       |                        let col_name = tm.select_columns.split(',').nth(i).map(|s| s.trim());
  638|       |                        let col_name = match col_name {
  639|       |                            Some(c) => c,
  640|       |                            None => {
  641|       |                                result
  642|       |                                    .errors
  643|       |                                    .push(format!("column mismatch at parameter index {}", i + 1));
  644|       |                                continue;
  645|       |                            }
  646|       |                        };
  647|       |                        if col_name == "auto_commit" || col_name == "active" {
  648|       |                            match row.try_get::<Option<i64>, _>(col_name)? {
  649|       |                                Some(v) => query = query.bind(v != 0),
  650|       |                                None => query = query.bind(None::<bool>),
  651|       |                            }
  652|       |                        } else if col_name == "step_index" || col_name == "entry_id" {
  653|       |                            match row.try_get::<Option<i64>, _>(col_name)? {
  654|       |                                Some(v) => query = query.bind(v),
  655|       |                                None => query = query.bind(None::<i64>),
  656|       |                            }
  657|       |                        } else {
  658|       |                            match row.try_get::<Option<String>, _>(col_name)? {
  659|       |                                Some(v) => query = query.bind(v),
  660|       |                                None => query = query.bind(None::<String>),
  661|       |                            }
  662|       |                        }
  663|       |                    }
  664|       |                    if let Err(e) = query.execute(pg).await {
  665|       |                        result.errors.push(format!("insert error: {}", e));
  666|       |                    } else {
  667|       |                        result.migrated_count += 1;
  668|       |                    }
  669|       |                }
  670|       |                result.errors.extend(chunk_errors);
  671|       |            }
  672|       |        }
  673|       |
  674|       |        result.source_content_hash = Some(aggregate_hash(source_hashes));
  675|       |
  676|       |        // Validate: count
  677|       |        let count_sql = format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {}", tm.name);
  678|       |        let target_count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(&count_sql).fetch_one(pg).await?;
  679|       |        result.target_count = target_count as usize;
  680|       |        result.count_match = result.target_count == result.source_count;
  681|       |
  682|       |        // Validate: ID set
  683|       |        if let Some(id_col) = tm.id_column {
  684|       |            let id_sql = format!("SELECT {} FROM {}", id_col, tm.name);
  685|       |            let target_rows = sqlx::query(&id_sql).fetch_all(pg).await?;
  686|       |            let target_ids: BTreeSet<String> = target_rows
  687|       |                .iter()
  688|       |                .filter_map(|row| row.try_get::<String, _>(id_col).ok())
  689|       |                .collect();
  690|       |            result.id_match = source_ids == target_ids;
  691|       |        }
  692|       |
  693|       |        // Validate: content hash
  694|       |        match compute_target_hash(pg, tm.name, tm.select_columns, chunk_size).await {
  695|       |            Ok(target_hash) => {
  696|       |                result.target_content_hash = Some(target_hash.clone());
  697|       |                result.hash_match = result.source_content_hash.as_ref().unwrap() == &target_hash;
  698|       |            }
  699|       |            Err(e) => {
  700|       |                result
  701|       |                    .errors
  702|       |                    .push(format!("target hash computation error: {}", e));
  703|       |                result.hash_match = false;
  704|       |            }
  705|       |        }
  706|       |    } else {
  707|       |        // Dry-run: just report what would happen
  708|       |        result.target_count = 0;
  709|       |        result.migrated_count = 0;
  710|       |    }
  711|       |
  712|       |    Ok(result)
  713|       |}

  765|       |#[cfg(feature = "postgres")]
  766|       |async fn run_migration(args: &Args) -> Result<MigrationReport> {
  767|       |    let sqlite = connect_sqlite(&args.from).await?;
  768|       |    let pg = connect_postgres(&args.to).await?;
  769|       |
  770|       |    // Apply target schema migrations before migration
  771|       |    if args.apply {
  772|       |        let pg_store = ferrum_store::postgres::PostgresStore::connect(&args.to).await?;
  773|       |        pg_store.apply_embedded_migrations().await?;
  774|       |        ensure_checkpoint_table(&pg).await?;
  775|       |        ensure_resume_idempotency_constraints(&pg).await?;
  776|       |    }
  777|       |
  778|       |    let migrations = table_migrations();
  779|       |    let mut tables = Vec::with_capacity(migrations.len());
  780|       |    let mut overall_success = true;
  781|       |
  782|       |    for tm in &migrations {
  783|       |        let source_count: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {}", tm.name))
  784|       |            .fetch_one(&sqlite)
  785|       |            .await?;
  786|       |
  787|       |        if args.apply && args.resume {
  788|       |            match checkpoint_action(
  789|       |                read_checkpoint(&pg, tm.name).await?,
  790|       |                source_count,
  791|       |                args.resume,
  792|       |                args.apply,
  793|       |            ) {
  794|       |                CheckpointAction::Skip => {
  795|       |                    let target_count: i64 =
  796|       |                        sqlx::query_scalar(&format!("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {}", tm.name))
  797|       |                            .fetch_one(&pg)
  798|       |                            .await?;
  799|       |                    let count_match = target_count == source_count;
  800|       |                    let source_hash =
  801|       |                        compute_source_hash(&sqlite, tm.name, tm.select_columns, args.chunk_size)
  802|       |                            .await;
  803|       |                    let target_hash =
  804|       |                        compute_target_hash(&pg, tm.name, tm.select_columns, args.chunk_size).await;
  805|       |                    let hash_match = matches!(
  806|       |                        (&source_hash, &target_hash),
  807|       |                        (Ok(source), Ok(target)) if source == target
  808|       |                    );
  809|       |                    let mut errors = Vec::new();
  810|       |                    if !count_match {
  811|       |                        errors.push(
  812|       |                            "checkpoint skip: target row count does not match checkpoint"
  813|       |                                .to_string(),
  814|       |                        );
  815|       |                    }
  816|       |                    if let Err(e) = &source_hash {
  817|       |                        errors.push(format!("checkpoint skip: source hash error: {}", e));
  818|       |                    }
  819|       |                    if let Err(e) = &target_hash {
  820|       |                        errors.push(format!("checkpoint skip: target hash error: {}", e));
  821|       |                    }
  822|       |                    if count_match && !hash_match {
  823|       |                        errors.push(
  824|       |                            "checkpoint skip: target content hash does not match source"
  825|       |                                .to_string(),
  826|       |                        );
  827|       |                    }
  828|       |                    if !count_match || !hash_match || !errors.is_empty() {
  829|       |                        overall_success = false;
  830|       |                    }
  831|       |                    tables.push(TableResult {
  832|       |                        table: tm.name.to_string(),
  833|       |                        source_count: source_count as usize,
  834|       |                        target_count: target_count as usize,
  835|       |                        migrated_count: 0,
  836|       |                        id_match: count_match,
  837|       |                        count_match,
  838|       |                        hash_match,
  839|       |                        source_content_hash: source_hash.ok(),
  840|       |                        target_content_hash: target_hash.ok(),
  841|       |                        errors,
  842|       |                    });
  843|       |                    continue;
  844|       |                }
  845|       |                CheckpointAction::DeleteStale => {
  846|       |                    delete_checkpoint(&pg, tm.name).await?;
  847|       |                }
  848|       |                CheckpointAction::Migrate => {}
  849|       |            }
  850|       |        }
  851|       |
  852|       |        match migrate_table(
  853|       |            &sqlite,
  854|       |            &pg,
  855|       |            tm,
  856|       |            args.apply,
  857|       |            args.chunk_size,
  858|       |            args.resume,
  859|       |            source_count as usize,
  860|       |        )
  861|       |        .await
  862|       |        {
  863|       |            Ok(tr) => {
  864|       |                let validation_clean = tr.validation_clean();
  865|       |                if !validation_clean {
  866|       |                    overall_success = false;
  867|       |                }
  868|       |                tables.push(tr);
  869|       |                if args.apply && validation_clean {
  870|       |                    if let Err(e) = write_checkpoint(&pg, tm.name, source_count).await {
  871|       |                        overall_success = false;
  872|       |                        if let Some(last) = tables.last_mut() {
  873|       |                            last.errors.push(format!("checkpoint write error: {}", e));
  874|       |                        }
  875|       |                    }
  876|       |                }
  877|       |            }
  878|       |            Err(e) => {
  879|       |                overall_success = false;
  880|       |                tables.push(TableResult {
  881|       |                    table: tm.name.to_string(),
  882|       |                    source_count: source_count as usize,
  883|       |                    target_count: 0,
  884|       |                    migrated_count: 0,
  885|       |                    id_match: false,
  886|       |                    count_match: false,
  887|       |                    hash_match: false,
  888|       |                    source_content_hash: None,
  889|       |                    target_content_hash: None,
  890|       |                    errors: vec![e.to_string()],
  891|       |                });
  892|       |            }
  893|       |        }
  894|       |    }
  895|       |
  896|       |    if args.apply {
  897|       |        if let Err(e) = reset_postgres_sequences(&pg).await {
  898|       |            overall_success = false;
  899|       |            tables.push(TableResult {
  900|       |                table: "_postgres_sequences".to_string(),
  901|       |                source_count: 0,
  902|       |                target_count: 0,
  903|       |                migrated_count: 0,
  904|       |                id_match: false,
  905|       |                count_match: false,
  906|       |                hash_match: false,
  907|       |                source_content_hash: None,
  908|       |                target_content_hash: None,
  909|       |                errors: vec![e.to_string()],
  910|       |            });
  911|       |        }
  912|       |    }
  913|       |
  914|       |    Ok(MigrationReport {
  915|       |        dry_run: !args.apply,
  916|       |        applied: args.apply,
  917|       |        overall_success,
  918|       |        tables,
  919|       |    })

 1375|       |    /// Skips if PostgreSQL is not reachable.
 1376|       |    #[cfg(feature = "postgres")]
 1377|       |    #[tokio::test]
 1378|       |    async fn test_migrate_intents_integration() {
 1379|       |        use ferrum_store::IntentRepo;
 1380|       |
 1381|       |        let pg_dsn = std::env::var("FERRUM_MIGRATE_TEST_PG_DSN").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
 1382|       |            "postgres://ferrumgate_dev:ferrumgate_dev_password@localhost:5432/ferrumgate_p2_test"
 1383|       |                .to_string()
 1384|       |        });
 1385|       |
 1386|       |        let pg = match connect_postgres(&pg_dsn).await {
 1387|       |            Ok(p) => p,
 1388|       |            Err(_) => {
 1389|       |                eprintln!("Skipping integration test: PostgreSQL not reachable");
 1390|       |                return;
 1391|       |            }
 1392|       |        };
 1393|       |
 1394|       |        // Set up target schema
 1395|       |        let pg_store = ferrum_store::postgres::PostgresStore::connect(&pg_dsn)
 1396|       |            .await
 1397|       |            .unwrap();
 1398|       |        pg_store.apply_embedded_migrations().await.unwrap();
 1399|       |
 1400|       |        // Clear target intents table for idempotency
 1401|       |        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM intents")
 1402|       |            .execute(&pg)
 1403|       |            .await
 1404|       |            .unwrap();
 1405|       |
 1406|       |        // Set up source SQLite with schema and one intent
 1407|       |        let sqlite_store = ferrum_store::SqliteStore::connect("sqlite::memory:")
 1408|       |            .await
 1409|       |            .unwrap();
 1410|       |        sqlite_store.apply_embedded_migrations().await.unwrap();
 1411|       |
 1412|       |        let intent_id = ferrum_proto::IntentId::new();
 1413|       |        let principal_id = ferrum_proto::PrincipalId::new();
 1414|       |        let intent = ferrum_proto::IntentEnvelope {
 1415|       |            intent_id,
 1416|       |            principal_id,
 1417|       |            session_id: None,
 1418|       |            channel_id: None,
 1419|       |            title: "test".to_string(),
 1420|       |            goal: "test goal".to_string(),

  693|       |    /// Sets file mtime to a specific unix timestamp using touch -t
  694|      2|    fn touch_with_mtime(path: &Path, timestamp_secs: u64) {
  695|       |        // touch -t format: YYYYMMDDhhmm
  696|       |        // Convert unix timestamp to YYYYMMDDHHMM
  697|      2|        let days = timestamp_secs / 86400;
  698|      2|        let rem = timestamp_secs % 86400;
  699|      2|        let hour = rem / 3600;
  700|      2|        let min = (rem % 3600) / 60;
  701|       |
  702|       |        // Calculate year/month/day from days since epoch (1970-01-01)
  703|      2|        let mut year = 1970;
  704|      2|        let mut remaining_days = days as i64;
  705|       |        loop {
  706|    114|            let days_in_year = if year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0) {
                                                                  ^28                ^2
  707|     28|                366
  708|       |            } else {
  709|     86|                365
  710|       |            };
  711|    114|            if remaining_days < days_in_year {
  712|      2|                break;
  713|    112|            }
  714|    112|            remaining_days -= days_in_year;
  715|    112|            year += 1;
  716|       |        }
  717|       |
  718|      2|        let month_days = if year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0) {
                                                            ^0                 ^0
  719|      0|            [31, 29, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
  720|       |        } else {
  721|      2|            [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
  722|       |        };
  723|       |
  724|      2|        let mut month = 1;
  725|      8|        for d in month_days.iter() {
                               ^2         ^2
  726|      8|            if remaining_days < *d as i64 {
  727|      2|                break;
  728|      6|            }
  729|      6|            remaining_days -= *d as i64;
  730|      6|            month += 1;
  731|       |        }
  732|      2|        let day = remaining_days + 1;
  733|       |
  734|      2|        let formatted = format!("{:04}{:02}{:02}{:02}{:02}", year, month, day, hour, min);
  735|      2|        std::process::Command::new("touch")
  736|      2|            .args(["-t", &formatted, &path.to_string_lossy()])
  737|      2|            .output()
  738|      2|            .expect("touch should succeed");
  739|      2|    }

  743|      1|        let temp_dir = tempfile::TempDir::new().unwrap();
  744|      1|        let db_path = temp_dir.path().join("test.db");
  745|      1|        let backup_dir = temp_dir.path().join("backups");
  746|       |
  747|       |        // Create a test database

  750|      1|            "CREATE TABLE test (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO test (id) VALUES (1);",
  751|       |        );
  752|       |
  753|       |        // Create output dir
  754|      1|        std::fs::create_dir_all(&backup_dir).unwrap();
  755|       |
  756|       |        // Create an old backup file manually (touch with old mtime)
  757|       |        // Note: backup files are named {db_name}_{timestamp}.db, db_name="test.db"

  759|      1|        std::fs::write(&old_backup, b"fake old backup").unwrap();
  760|       |

  771|      1|        std::fs::write(&recent_backup, b"fake recent backup").unwrap();
  772|       |

   88|       |/// Nodes are events, edges are parent-child relationships derived from parent_edges.
   89|       |/// Output is deterministic: events sorted by event_id, edges sorted by (from, to).
   90|      3|fn render_dot(execution_id: &str, events: &[client::ProvenanceEvent]) -> String {
   91|       |    // Sort events by event_id for deterministic output

 3900|      1|            ("1.2.3", BumpType::Major, "2.0.0"),
 3901|      1|            ("0.0.1", BumpType::Major, "1.0.0"),
 3902|      1|            ("0.0.1", BumpType::Minor, "0.1.0"),
 3903|       |        ];
 3904|       |
 3905|      8|        for (original, bump_type, expected) in test_cases {
                                                             ^1
 3906|      8|            let mut version_parts: Vec<u32> =
 3907|     24|                original.split('.').filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
                              ^8       ^8         ^8                             ^8
 3908|       |
 3909|      8|            while version_parts.len() < 3 {
 3910|      0|                version_parts.push(0);
 3911|      0|            }
 3912|       |
 3913|      8|            match bump_type {
 3914|      3|                BumpType::Major => {
 3915|      3|                    version_parts[0] += 1;
 3916|      3|                    version_parts[1] = 0;
 3917|      3|                    version_parts[2] = 0;
 3918|      3|                }
 3919|      3|                BumpType::Minor => {
 3920|      3|                    version_parts[1] += 1;
 3921|      3|                    version_parts[2] = 0;
 3922|      3|                }
 3923|      2|                BumpType::Patch => {
 3924|      2|                    version_parts[2] += 1;
 3925|      2|                }
 3926|       |            }
 3927|       |
 3928|      8|            let new_version = format!(
 3929|       |                "{}.{}.{}",
 3930|      8|                version_parts[0], version_parts[1], version_parts[2]
 3931|       |            );
 3932|      8|            assert_eq!(
 3933|       |                new_version, expected,
 3934|       |                "bumping {} with {:?} should give {}",
 3935|       |                original, bump_type, expected
 3936|       |            );
 3937|       |        }
 3938|      1|    }

    1|       |//! Filesystem adapter for mutation and recovery.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This adapter implements the `RollbackAdapter` trait for filesystem operations,
    4|       |//! supporting prepare→verify lifecycle on file paths with FileExists and FileHashMatches checks.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! # FileWrite Recovery Slice
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! This adapter supports bounded FileWrite snapshot/recovery for **existing-file writes**:
    9|       |//! - `prepare`: captures a deterministic snapshot of the existing file's contents
   10|       |//! - `execute`: writes new contents to the target file (caller-provided payload)
   11|       |//! - `rollback`/`compensate`: restores the file from the captured snapshot
   12|       |//!
   13|       |//! This adapter also supports bounded FileWrite for **new-file creation**:
   14|       |//! - `prepare`: validates parent directory exists, marks `created_new_file: true` in metadata
   15|       |//! - `execute`: writes new contents to the target file
   16|       |//! - `rollback`/`compensate`: removes the created file (idempotent if already absent)
   17|       |//!
   18|       |//! # FileDelete Recovery Slice (P2.1)
   19|       |//!
   20|       |//! This adapter also supports bounded FileDelete snapshot/recovery for **existing files only**:
   21|       |//! - `prepare`: captures a deterministic snapshot of the existing file's contents; fails closed if file does not exist
   22|       |//! - `execute`: deletes the target file
   23|       |//! - `rollback`/`compensate`: restores the file from the captured snapshot
   24|       |

  118|       |/// Filesystem adapter implementing the RollbackAdapter trait.
  119|       |///
  120|       |/// Uses file paths to provide prepare→verify lifecycle testing with snapshot-based
  121|       |/// recovery for bounded FileWrite and FileDelete operations, including new-file

  591|       |impl From<FsAdapterError> for AdapterError {
  592|     10|    fn from(err: FsAdapterError) -> Self {
  593|     10|        match err {
  594|      0|            FsAdapterError::InvalidTarget(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  595|     10|            FsAdapterError::FilePathNotFound(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  596|      0|            FsAdapterError::UnsupportedAction(msg) => AdapterError::Unsupported(msg),
  597|      0|            FsAdapterError::UnsupportedCheck(msg) => AdapterError::Unsupported(msg),
  598|      0|            FsAdapterError::Validation(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  599|      0|            FsAdapterError::Io(err) => AdapterError::Internal(err.to_string()),
  600|      0|            FsAdapterError::SnapshotNotFound(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  601|      0|            FsAdapterError::FileNotExisting(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  602|      0|            FsAdapterError::ParentDirNotFound(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  603|      0|            FsAdapterError::DirAlreadyExists(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  604|      0|            FsAdapterError::DirNotFound(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  605|      0|            FsAdapterError::DirNotEmpty(msg) => AdapterError::Validation(msg),
  606|      0|            FsAdapterError::FileSizeExceedsLimit(size, limit) => {

 1103|       |                        ));

 1106|       |                    return Err(AdapterError::Validation(
 1107|       |                        "payload must be a string or object with 'content' field".into(),
 1108|       |                    ));

 1600|     43|    async fn verify(&self, contract: &RollbackContract) -> Result<VerifyReceipt, AdapterError> {
 1601|       |        // Validate target
 1602|       |        let file_path = Self::extract_path(&contract.target)?;
 1603|       |
 1604|       |        // ALWAYS run action-aware default target-state verification first:
 1605|       |        // - FileWrite: verify file exists (post-execute state should have the file present)
 1606|       |        // - FileDelete: verify file does NOT exist (post-execute state should have the file absent)

 1608|       |        // explicit checks from bypassing the fundamental target-state invariant.

 1616|       |                    )
 1617|      4|                })?;
 1618|       |            }
 1619|       |            ActionType::FileDelete => {
 1620|       |                // Fail-closed: file must NOT exist after delete (phase-aware error wrapping)
 1621|       |                let p = Path::new(file_path);
 1622|       |                if p.exists() && p.is_file() {

 1624|       |                        PHASE_VERIFY,

 1626|       |                    ));

crates/ferrum-adapter-gcs/src/lib.rs:
    1|       |//! GCS adapter for mutation and recovery.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This adapter implements the `RollbackAdapter` trait for Google Cloud Storage
    4|       |//! object operations, modeling generation/metageneration for rollback and using
    5|       |//! fail-closed precondition semantics.
    6|       |//!
    7|       |//! # Recovery Slice (P2-4)
    8|       |//!
    9|       |//! The adapter supports bounded GCS object operations with generation-based
   10|       |//! rollback:
   11|       |//! - `prepare`: validates bucket/key against the allowlist and captures the
   12|       |//!   object's current `generation` (if provided) as `before_generation`.
   13|       |//! - `execute`: performs the GCS operation (put, delete, get). For mutating
   14|       |//!   operations, captures the resulting `generation` / `metageneration` as
   15|       |//!   `after_generation` / `after_metageneration`.
   16|       |//! - `rollback`/`compensate`: for mutating operations, fails closed unless both
   17|       |//!   `before_generation` and `after_generation` are present. Live GCS recovery
   18|       |//!   is gated by the `gcs-client` feature and `live: true`.
   19|       |//!
   20|       |//! # Limitations
   21|       |//!
   22|       |//! - Live GCS execution is implemented behind the `gcs-client` feature and the
   23|       |//!   `live` config flag. When both are enabled, real GCS calls would be made.
   24|       |//!   This slice ships a shape-only implementation; the live client path returns
   25|       |//!   a clear "not implemented" error so it cannot silently execute.
   26|       |//! - `live: false` is the default. In this mode all phases perform shape-only
   27|       |//!   validation and return `execution_groundwork=true`.
   28|       |//! - Single-bucket allowlist only; no bucket creation/IAM/ACL admin.
   29|       |//! - Max object size is enforced at the adapter boundary, not by GCS itself.
   30|       |//! - No resumable upload, multi-bucket allowlists, signed URLs, retention, or
   31|       |//!   lifecycle management.
   32|       |//! - Azure Blob is deferred; see ADR-018.
   33|       |
   34|       |use async_trait::async_trait;
   35|       |use chrono::Utc;

   41|       |};

  723|      3|    async fn verify(&self, contract: &RollbackContract) -> Result<VerifyReceipt, AdapterError> {
  724|       |        self.ensure_shape_only()?;
  725|       |
  726|       |        let (bucket, key, _generation) = Self::extract_gcs_target(&contract.target)?;
  727|       |
  728|       |        if let Err(e) = self.validate_bucket_allowlist(bucket) {
  729|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_VERIFY, e.to_string()));
  730|       |        }
  731|       |        if let Err(e) = Self::validate_object_key(key) {
  732|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_VERIFY, e.to_string()));

  740|       |                 the operation had the expected effect."
  741|       |                    .to_string(),
  742|       |            ));
  743|       |        }
  744|       |
  745|       |        for check in &contract.verify_checks {
  746|       |            self.run_check_live(check, bucket, key, PHASE_VERIFY)
  747|       |                .await?;
  748|       |        }
  749|       |
  750|       |        Ok(VerifyReceipt {
  751|       |            verified: true,
  752|       |            adapter_metadata: JsonMap::new(),
  753|       |        })
  754|      3|    }

  799|       |    /// Shared rollback/compensate logic for generation-based recovery.
  800|       |    ///
  801|       |    /// For mutating operations (PutObject, DeleteObject), the recovery strategy
  802|       |    /// is to restore the object to `before_generation`. When `live: true`, the
  803|       |    /// adapter would issue a GCS copy or delete with `ifGenerationMatch`
  804|       |    /// preconditions. In this slice, the live path is not implemented, so the
  805|       |    /// method always returns `recovered=false` unless the action is read-only.
  806|      3|    async fn rollback_or_compensate(
  807|      3|        &self,
  808|      3|        contract: &RollbackContract,
  809|      3|        phase: &'static str,
  810|      3|    ) -> Result<RecoveryReceipt, AdapterError> {
  811|      3|        self.ensure_shape_only()?;
                                              ^1
  812|       |
  813|      2|        let (bucket, key, _generation) = Self::extract_gcs_target(&contract.target)?;
                                                                                                 ^0
  814|       |
  815|      2|        if let Err(e) = self.validate_bucket_allowlist(bucket) {
                                 ^0
  816|      0|            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(phase, e.to_string()));
  817|      2|        }
  818|      2|        if let Err(e) = Self::validate_object_key(key) {
                                 ^0
  819|      0|            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(phase, e.to_string()));
  820|      2|        }
  821|       |
  822|      2|        match contract.action_type {
  823|       |            ActionType::GcsPutObject | ActionType::GcsDeleteObject => {
  824|      1|                let before_generation = contract
  825|      1|                    .metadata
  826|      1|                    .get("before_generation")

                                                   ^0^0          ^0            ^0^0       ^0

  829|      1|                    .metadata
  830|      1|                    .get("after_generation")
  831|      1|                    .and_then(|v| if v.is_null() { None } else { v.as_i64() });
                                                   ^0^0          ^0            ^0^0       ^0
  832|       |
  833|      1|                if before_generation.is_none() {
  834|      1|                    return Err(GcsAdapterError::MissingBeforeGeneration.into());
  835|      0|                }
  836|      0|                if after_generation.is_none() {
  837|      0|                    return Err(GcsAdapterError::MissingAfterGeneration.into());
  838|      0|                }
  839|       |
  840|       |                // Live rollback would use ifGenerationMatch preconditions here.
  841|       |                // Shape-only slice: report not recovered.
  842|      0|                let mut metadata = JsonMap::new();
  843|      0|                metadata.insert(
  844|      0|                    "adapter_kind".to_string(),

  846|       |                );

  850|       |                );
  851|      0|                metadata.insert("recovered".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
  852|      0|                metadata.insert(
  853|      0|                    "reason".to_string(),
  854|      0|                    serde_json::Value::String(
  855|      0|                        "GCS rollback/compensate requires a live client; live GCS is not implemented in this slice"
  856|      0|                            .to_string(),
  857|      0|                    ),
  858|       |                );
  859|      0|                metadata.insert(
  860|      0|                    "before_generation".to_string(),
  861|      0|                    before_generation
  862|      0|                        .map(|g| serde_json::Value::Number(g.into()))
  863|      0|                        .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
  864|       |                );
  865|      0|                metadata.insert(

  869|      0|                        .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
  870|       |                );
  871|      0|                metadata.insert(
  872|      0|                    "bucket".to_string(),
  873|      0|                    serde_json::Value::String(bucket.to_string()),
  874|       |                );
  875|      0|                metadata.insert(
  876|      0|                    "object_key".to_string(),
  877|      0|                    serde_json::Value::String(key.to_string()),
  878|       |                );
  879|       |
  880|      0|                Ok(RecoveryReceipt {
  881|      0|                    recovered: false,
  882|      0|                    adapter_metadata: metadata,
  883|      0|                })

    3|       |//! Generates execution plans for GCS object actions with appropriate
    4|       |//! prepare_checks, verify_checks, and compensation_plan steps.
    5|       |

    8|       |use ferrum_rollback::{AdapterError, PlannableAdapter};
    9|       |use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
   10|       |
   11|       |static ID_COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(1);
   12|       |
   13|       |/// Generates a unique idempotency key for compensation steps.
   14|      2|fn next_idempotency_key() -> String {
   15|      2|    format!("planner-gcs-{}", ID_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst))
   16|      2|}
   17|       |
   18|       |/// Converts a serde_json::Map to a JsonMap (IndexMap).
   19|      6|fn json_map_from_serde_map(map: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>) -> JsonMap {
   20|      6|    map.into_iter().collect()
   21|      6|}
   22|       |
   23|       |/// Planner for GCS adapter actions.
   24|       |///
   25|       |/// For GCS mutating operations + GcsObject, generates an execution plan with:
   26|       |///
   27|       |/// - **prepare_checks**: `GcsObjectExists` (if the operation expects the object to exist)
   28|       |/// - **verify_checks**: `GcsGenerationMatches` placeholder (to be filled after execute)
   29|       |/// - **compensation_plan**: A placeholder `gcs.generation_rollback_v1` step with
   30|       |///   `before_generation` and `after_generation` args to be filled at execution time.
   31|       |///
   32|       |/// Read-only operations (`GcsGetObject`) produce no compensation plan.
   33|       |pub struct PlannableGcsAdapter;
   34|       |
   35|       |#[async_trait]
   36|       |impl PlannableAdapter for PlannableGcsAdapter {
   37|       |    async fn generate_plan(
   38|       |        &self,
   39|       |        action_type: &ActionType,
   40|       |        target: &RollbackTarget,
   41|      5|    ) -> Result<Option<ExecutionPlan>, AdapterError> {
   42|       |        match (action_type, target) {
   43|       |            (
   44|       |                ActionType::GcsPutObject | ActionType::GcsDeleteObject,
   45|       |                RollbackTarget::GcsObject { bucket, key, .. },
   46|       |            ) => {
   47|       |                let mut prepare_checks = Vec::new();
   48|       |                let mut verify_checks = Vec::new();
   49|       |                let mut compensation_plan = Vec::new();
   50|       |
   51|       |                // Delete expects the object to exist; Put may create it.
   52|      5|                if matches!(action_type, ActionType::GcsDeleteObject) {
   53|       |                    prepare_checks.push(ferrum_proto::CheckSpec {
   54|       |                        check_type: ferrum_proto::CheckType::GcsObjectExists,
   55|       |                        config: json_map_from_serde_map(
   56|       |                            serde_json::json!({
   57|       |                                "bucket": bucket.clone(),
   58|       |                                "key": key.clone()
   59|       |                            })
   60|       |                            .as_object()
   61|       |                            .unwrap()
   62|       |                            .clone(),
   63|       |                        ),
   64|       |                    });
   65|       |                }
   66|       |
   67|       |                verify_checks.push(ferrum_proto::CheckSpec {
   68|       |                    check_type: ferrum_proto::CheckType::GcsGenerationMatches,
   69|       |                    config: json_map_from_serde_map(
   70|       |                        serde_json::json!({
   71|       |                            "bucket": bucket.clone(),
   72|       |                            "key": key.clone(),
   73|       |                            "expected_generation": "TBD"
   74|       |                        })
   75|       |                        .as_object()
   76|       |                        .unwrap()
   77|       |                        .clone(),
   78|       |                    ),
   79|       |                });
   80|       |
   81|       |                compensation_plan.push(CompensationStep {
   82|       |                    order: 1,
   83|       |                    adapter_key: "gcs".to_string(),
   84|       |                    operation: "gcs.generation_rollback_v1".to_string(),
   85|       |                    args: json_map_from_serde_map(
   86|       |                        serde_json::json!({
   87|       |                            "bucket": bucket.clone(),
   88|       |                            "key": key.clone(),
   89|       |                            "before_generation": "TBD",
   90|       |                            "after_generation": "TBD"
   91|       |                        })
   92|       |                        .as_object()
   93|       |                        .unwrap()
   94|       |                        .clone(),
   95|       |                    ),
   96|       |                    idempotency_key: next_idempotency_key(),
   97|       |                });
   98|       |
   99|       |                Ok(Some(ExecutionPlan {
  100|       |                    prepare_checks,
  101|       |                    verify_checks,
  102|       |                    compensation_plan,
  103|       |                    auto_commit: false,
  104|       |                    plan_description: format!("gcs {:?} plan for {}/{}", action_type, bucket, key),
  105|       |                }))
  106|       |            }
  107|       |            (ActionType::GcsGetObject, RollbackTarget::GcsObject { bucket, key, .. }) => {
  108|       |                Ok(Some(ExecutionPlan {
  109|       |                    prepare_checks: Vec::new(),
  110|       |                    verify_checks: vec![ferrum_proto::CheckSpec {
  111|       |                        check_type: ferrum_proto::CheckType::GcsObjectExists,
  112|       |                        config: json_map_from_serde_map(
  113|       |                            serde_json::json!({
  114|       |                                "bucket": bucket.clone(),
  115|       |                                "key": key.clone()
  116|       |                            })
  117|       |                            .as_object()
  118|       |                            .unwrap()
  119|       |                            .clone(),
  120|       |                        ),
  121|       |                    }],
  122|       |                    compensation_plan: Vec::new(),
  123|       |                    auto_commit: true,
  124|       |                    plan_description: format!("gcs GcsGetObject plan for {}/{}", bucket, key),
  125|       |                }))
  126|       |            }
  127|       |            _ => Ok(None), // Not plannable by this adapter
  128|       |        }
  129|      5|    }
  130|       |}

   18|       |    #[error("unsupported action: {0}")]

   22|       |    #[error("internal: {0}")]
   23|       |    Internal(String),

   26|       |}
   27|       |
   28|       |impl From<GitAdapterError> for AdapterError {
   29|      6|    fn from(e: GitAdapterError) -> Self {
   30|      6|        match e {
   31|      0|            GitAdapterError::Unsupported(s) => AdapterError::Unsupported(s),
   32|      5|            GitAdapterError::Validation(s) => AdapterError::Validation(s),
   33|      0|            GitAdapterError::Internal(s) => AdapterError::Internal(s),
   34|      1|            GitAdapterError::GitError(s) => AdapterError::Internal(s),
   35|       |        }
   36|      6|    }
   37|       |}

   39|       |/// GitRollbackAdapter provides local git repository ref capture and reset primitives.
   40|       |///
   41|       |/// Supported operations:

crates/ferrum-adapter-http/src/lib.rs:
    1|       |//! HTTP adapter for mutation and idempotency-aware compensation.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This adapter implements the `RollbackAdapter` trait for HTTP operations,
    4|       |//! supporting prepare→verify lifecycle with HttpStatusExpected checks.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! # HttpMutation Recovery Slice
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! This adapter supports bounded HttpMutation execute for **request execution with receipt capture**:
    9|       |//! - `prepare`: validates target/method/url shape and optionally validates prepare checks
   10|       |//!   if they use `HttpStatusExpected` (making a request to check endpoint reachability)
   11|       |//! - `execute`: sends real HTTP requests to the target URL using the specified method,
   12|       |//!   captures request metadata (method, URL, request digest), response status, and bounded
   13|       |//!   response digest/size. Fail-closed on connection/timeout/parse errors with phase-aware
   14|       |//!   internal normalization. Supports payload body (string, number, bool, null, or object
   15|       |//!   with "body" field).
   16|       |//! - `verify`: supports explicit `HttpStatusExpected` checks against a local test server/endpoint
   17|       |//!   and fail-closes on mismatch or request error
   18|       |//!
   19|       |//! # Limitations
   20|       |//!
   21|       |//! - Only `HttpStatusExpected` checks are supported; other check types return unsupported error.
   22|       |//! - Rollback and compensate require a valid `http.replay_v1` compensation plan with idempotency key;
   23|       |//!   unsupported shapes return `AdapterError::Unsupported` with structured reason codes.
   24|       |

   23|       |/// Planner for HTTP adapter actions.
   24|       |///
   25|       |/// For HttpMutation + HttpRequest, generates an execution plan with:
   26|       |///
   27|       |/// - **prepare_checks**: None (HttpAdapter prepare validates URL/method shape internally)
   28|       |/// - **verify_checks**: None (HttpAdapter verify runs HttpStatusExpected checks internally)
   29|       |/// - **compensation_plan**: A placeholder http.replay_v1 step. The args are intentionally
   30|       |///   incomplete so that HttpAdapter.execute ignores it (parse_replay_contract fails),
   31|       |///   while keeping compensation_plan non-empty so Invariant 9 passes for R2Compensatable.
   32|       |///   Callers that need real replay compensation must populate the compensation_plan with
   33|       |///   valid method, url, payload, and expected_statuses before compensate.
   34|       |pub struct PlannableHttpAdapter;
   35|       |
   36|       |#[async_trait]
   37|       |impl PlannableAdapter for PlannableHttpAdapter {
   38|       |    async fn generate_plan(
   39|       |        &self,
   40|       |        action_type: &ActionType,
   41|       |        target: &RollbackTarget,
   42|      3|    ) -> Result<Option<ExecutionPlan>, AdapterError> {
   43|       |        match (action_type, target) {
   44|       |            (
   45|       |                ActionType::HttpMutation,
   46|       |                RollbackTarget::HttpRequest {
   47|       |                    method: _,
   48|       |                    url,
   49|       |                    request_digest: _,
   50|       |                },
   51|       |            ) => {
   52|       |                // Generate a placeholder replay step with incomplete args.
   53|       |                // This keeps compensation_plan non-empty for Invariant 9,
   54|       |                // but parse_replay_contract will fail so execute won't
   55|       |                // try to validate a digest against an empty request_digest.
   56|       |                Ok(Some(ExecutionPlan {
   57|       |                    prepare_checks: Vec::new(),
   58|       |                    verify_checks: Vec::new(),
   59|       |                    compensation_plan: vec![CompensationStep {
   60|       |                        order: 1,
   61|       |                        adapter_key: "http".to_string(),
   62|       |                        operation: "http.replay_v1".to_string(),
   63|       |                        args: json_map_from_serde_map(
   64|       |                            serde_json::json!({
   65|       |                                "url": url.clone()
   66|       |                            })
   67|       |                            .as_object()
   68|       |                            .unwrap()
   69|       |                            .clone(),
   70|       |                        ),
   71|       |                        idempotency_key: next_idempotency_key(),
   72|       |                    }],
   73|       |                    auto_commit: false,
   74|       |                    plan_description: format!("http mutation plan for {}", url),
   75|       |                }))
   76|       |            }
   77|       |            _ => Ok(None), // Not plannable by this adapter
   78|       |        }
   79|      3|    }

crates/ferrum-adapter-maildraft/src/lib.rs:
    1|       |//! MailDraft adapter for email draft management with rollback support.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This adapter implements the `RollbackAdapter` trait for email draft operations,
    4|       |//! supporting create, update, and delete operations on drafts stored in memory.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! # Operations
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! - **Create**: prepare validates draft_id is new, execute stores, verify confirms exists, rollback deletes
    9|       |//! - **Update**: prepare captures original draft, execute overwrites, verify confirms new content, rollback restores original
   10|       |//! - **Delete**: prepare captures draft content, execute removes, verify confirms gone, rollback recreates
   11|       |//!
   12|       |//! The operation type is determined by `request.metadata["operation"]` ("create", "update", "delete").
   13|       |
   14|       |use async_trait::async_trait;
   15|       |use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
   16|       |use ferrum_proto::{ActionType, JsonMap, RollbackContract, RollbackPrepareRequest, RollbackTarget};
   17|       |use ferrum_rollback::{
   18|       |    AdapterError, ExecuteReceipt, PrepareReceipt, RecoveryReceipt, RollbackAdapter, VerifyReceipt,
   19|       |};
   20|       |use std::collections::HashMap;
   21|       |use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
   22|       |use thiserror::Error;
   23|       |
   24|       |pub const ADAPTER_KIND: &str = "ferrum-adapter-maildraft";
   25|       |
   26|       |/// Atomic counter for generating unique placeholder draft IDs during prepare.
   27|       |static DRAFT_ID_COUNTER: std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64 = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(1);
   28|       |
   29|       |/// Generates a unique placeholder draft ID for create operations when gateway doesn't provide one.
   30|      2|fn next_placeholder_draft_id() -> String {
   31|      2|    format!(
   32|       |        "placeholder-{}",
   33|      2|        DRAFT_ID_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst)
   34|       |    )
   35|      2|}
   36|       |
   37|       |/// Phase context for error normalization.
   38|       |const PHASE_PREPARE: &str = "prepare";
   39|       |const PHASE_VERIFY: &str = "verify";
   40|       |const PHASE_EXECUTE: &str = "execute";

 1538|       |    #[tokio::test]
 1539|      1|    async fn test_maildraft_rollback_create_idempotent() {
 1540|       |        // Verify that rollback on an already-deleted draft (via prior rollback) is idempotent.
 1541|      1|        let adapter = MailDraftAdapter::new("maildraft");
 1542|      1|        let store = Arc::clone(&adapter.store);
 1543|       |
 1544|      1|        let request = create_test_request("idempotent-create-draft", OP_CREATE);
 1545|      1|        let prep_receipt = adapter.prepare(&request).await.unwrap();
 1546|       |
 1547|      1|        let contract = create_test_contract(
 1548|      1|            "idempotent-create-draft",
 1549|      1|            OP_CREATE,
 1550|      1|            prep_receipt.adapter_metadata,
 1551|       |        );
 1552|      1|        adapter
 1553|      1|            .execute(&contract, &serde_json::json!({}))
 1554|      1|            .await
 1555|      1|            .unwrap();
 1556|       |
 1557|       |        // First rollback: deletes the draft
 1558|      1|        let rollback_receipt1 = adapter.rollback(&contract).await.unwrap();
 1559|      1|        assert!(rollback_receipt1.recovered);
 1560|       |
 1561|       |        // Verify draft is gone after first rollback
 1562|       |        {
 1563|      1|            let store_lock = store.lock().unwrap();
 1564|      1|            assert!(!store_lock.contains("idempotent-create-draft"));
 1565|       |        }
 1566|       |
 1567|       |        // Second rollback: should succeed (idempotent) — draft already deleted
 1568|      1|        let rollback_receipt2 = adapter.rollback(&contract).await.unwrap();
 1569|      1|        assert!(rollback_receipt2.recovered);

crates/ferrum-adapter-s3/src/lib.rs:
    1|       |//! S3 adapter for mutation and recovery.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This adapter implements the `RollbackAdapter` trait for S3-compatible object operations,
    4|       |//! supporting prepare→verify lifecycle with versioning-based rollback semantics.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! # Recovery Slice (PR4)
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! The adapter supports bounded S3 object operations with **versioning-based rollback**:
    9|       |//! - `prepare`: validates bucket/key against allowlist, checks that versioning is enabled,
   10|       |//!   and captures the current version ID (if the object exists) as `before_version_id`.
   11|       |//! - `execute`: performs the S3 operation (put, delete, get, copy). For mutating operations,
   12|       |//!   captures the resulting version ID / delete marker as `after_version_id`.
   13|       |//! - `rollback`/`compensate`: for **mutating** operations, restores the previous state by
   14|       |//!   deleting the newly created version / delete marker, making the `before_version_id`
   15|       |//!   the current version again.
   16|       |//!
   17|       |//! # Limitations
   18|       |//!
   19|       |//! - Live S3 execution is implemented behind the `live` config flag. When `live: true`,
   20|       |//!   real AWS SDK calls are made and failures fail closed. When `live: false` (default),
   21|       |//!   the adapter falls back to shape-only validation for safe unit testing.
   22|       |//! - Single-bucket allowlist only; no bucket creation/IAM/ACL admin.
   23|       |//! - Max object size is enforced at the adapter boundary, not by S3 itself.
   24|       |//! - Multipart upload, lifecycle, presigned URLs, replication, and batch deletion are out of scope.
   25|       |//! - MinIO integration tests exist but are gated (`#[ignored]`) and require a local Docker container.
   26|       |
   27|       |use async_trait::async_trait;
   28|       |use chrono::Utc;
   29|       |use ferrum_proto::{
   30|       |    ActionType, CheckType, JsonMap, RollbackContract, RollbackPrepareRequest, RollbackTarget,
   31|       |};

   34|       |};
   35|       |use regex::Regex;
   36|       |use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
   37|       |use std::sync::OnceLock;
   38|       |use thiserror::Error;

  435|       |
  436|       |    /// Builds or returns the cached AWS S3 client.
  437|       |    ///
  438|       |    /// Returns Err if `live` is false. This allows unit tests to run without
  439|       |    /// real credentials while still failing closed when a live client is
  440|       |    /// configured but the S3 call fails.
  441|       |    ///
  442|       |    /// When `live` is true, `aws_config::from_env()` is used, which supports
  443|       |    /// explicit credentials, environment variables, and the AWS default
  444|       |    /// credential chain (including IAM roles).
  445|       |    #[cfg(feature = "s3-client")]
  446|       |    async fn client(&self) -> Result<aws_sdk_s3::Client, AdapterError> {
  447|       |        if !self.config.live {
  448|       |            return Err(AdapterError::Validation(
  449|       |                "S3 live mode is not enabled; set live=true to use live S3 calls".into(),
  450|       |            ));
  451|       |        }
  452|       |        {
  453|       |            let lock = self.client.lock().unwrap();
  454|       |            if let Some(client) = lock.clone() {
  455|       |                return Ok(client);
  456|       |            }
  457|       |        }
  458|       |        let mut aws_cfg = aws_config::from_env()
  459|       |            .region(aws_sdk_s3::config::Region::new(self.config.region.clone()));
  460|       |        if let Some(ref endpoint) = self.config.endpoint_url {
  461|       |            aws_cfg = aws_cfg.endpoint_url(endpoint.clone());
  462|       |        }
  463|       |        if let (Some(key), Some(secret)) =
  464|       |            (&self.config.access_key_id, &self.config.secret_access_key)
  465|       |        {
  466|       |            let creds = aws_credential_types::Credentials::new(
  467|       |                key.clone(),
  468|       |                secret.clone(),
  469|       |                None,
  470|       |                None,
  471|       |                "ferrum-adapter-s3",
  472|       |            );
  473|       |            aws_cfg = aws_cfg.credentials_provider(creds);
  474|       |        }
  475|       |        let shared_cfg = aws_cfg.load().await;
  476|       |        let mut s3_builder = aws_sdk_s3::config::Builder::from(&shared_cfg);
  477|       |        if self.config.endpoint_url.is_some() {
  478|       |            s3_builder = s3_builder.force_path_style(true);
  479|       |        }
  480|       |        let client = aws_sdk_s3::Client::from_conf(s3_builder.build());
  481|       |        let mut lock = self.client.lock().unwrap();
  482|       |        *lock = Some(client.clone());
  483|       |        Ok(client)
  484|       |    }

  490|       |    async fn run_check_live(

  492|       |        check: &ferrum_proto::CheckSpec,
  493|       |        bucket: &str,

  527|       |                    Ok(())
  528|       |                }
  529|       |            }
  530|       |            CheckType::S3VersionIdMatches => {
  531|       |                // Validate 'bucket' and 'key' fields if present
  532|       |                if let Some(serde_json::Value::String(check_bucket)) = check.config.get("bucket") {
  533|       |                    if check_bucket != bucket {
  534|       |                        return Err(AdapterError::Validation(format!(

  536|       |                            check_bucket, bucket

  538|       |                    }
  539|       |                }

  541|       |                    if check_key != key {

  543|       |                            "S3VersionIdMatches check key mismatch: check targets '{}', expected '{}'",
  544|       |                            check_key, key

  546|       |                    }
  547|       |                }
  548|       |                let expected = check.config.get("expected_version_id").ok_or_else(|| {
  549|       |                    AdapterError::Validation(

  553|       |                // Live check: try HeadObject if client available

  559|       |                            if actual != Some(expected_str) {

  564|       |                            }
  565|       |                            Ok(())
  566|       |                        }
  567|       |                        Err(e) => Err(AdapterError::Validation(format!(

  569|       |                            bucket, key, e
  570|       |                        ))),
  571|       |                    }
  572|       |                } else {
  573|       |                    Ok(())
  574|       |                }
  575|       |            }
  576|       |            _ => Err(AdapterError::Unsupported(format!(

  622|       |impl RollbackAdapter for S3Adapter {
  623|      0|    fn key(&self) -> &'static str {
  624|      0|        self.key
  625|      0|    }
  626|       |
  627|       |    async fn prepare(
  628|       |        &self,
  629|       |        request: &RollbackPrepareRequest,
  630|      4|    ) -> Result<PrepareReceipt, AdapterError> {
  631|       |        // Validate target is S3Object
  632|       |        let (bucket, key, version_id) = Self::extract_s3_target(&request.target)?;
  633|       |
  634|       |        // Validate that action_type is one of the four S3 operations
  635|      4|        match request.action_type {
  636|       |            ActionType::S3PutObject
  637|       |            | ActionType::S3DeleteObject
  638|       |            | ActionType::S3GetObject
  639|       |            | ActionType::S3CopyObject => {}
  640|       |            _ => {
  641|       |                return Err(AdapterError::Unsupported(format!(
  642|       |                    "unsupported action type: {:?}",
  643|       |                    request.action_type
  644|       |                )));
  645|       |            }
  646|       |        }
  647|       |
  648|       |        // Validate bucket allowlist
  649|       |        if let Err(e) = self.validate_bucket_allowlist(bucket) {
  650|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_PREPARE, e.to_string()));
  651|       |        }
  652|       |
  653|       |        // Validate object key
  654|       |        if let Err(e) = Self::validate_object_key(key) {
  655|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_PREPARE, e.to_string()));
  656|       |        }
  657|       |
  658|       |        // Validate versioning requirement (live if client available, config-only otherwise)
  659|       |        if let Err(e) = self.validate_versioning_requirement_live(bucket).await {
  660|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_PREPARE, e.to_string()));
  661|       |        }
  662|       |
  663|       |        // Run prepare_checks if present
  664|       |        for check in &request.prepare_checks {
  665|       |            self.run_check_live(check, bucket, key, PHASE_PREPARE)
  666|       |                .await?;
  667|       |        }
  668|       |
  669|       |        let mut metadata = JsonMap::new();
  670|       |        metadata.insert(
  671|       |            "adapter_kind".to_string(),
  672|       |            serde_json::Value::String(ADAPTER_KIND.to_string()),
  673|       |        );
  674|       |        metadata.insert(
  675|       |            "prepared_at".to_string(),
  676|       |            serde_json::Value::String(Utc::now().to_rfc3339()),
  677|       |        );
  678|       |        metadata.insert(
  679|       |            "bucket".to_string(),
  680|       |            serde_json::Value::String(bucket.to_string()),
  681|       |        );
  682|       |        metadata.insert(
  683|       |            "object_key".to_string(),
  684|       |            serde_json::Value::String(key.to_string()),
  685|       |        );
  686|       |
  687|       |        // Capture before_version_id via live HeadObject if client available
  688|       |        #[cfg(feature = "s3-client")]

 1151|      2|    async fn verify(&self, contract: &RollbackContract) -> Result<VerifyReceipt, AdapterError> {
 1152|       |        let (bucket, key, _version_id) = Self::extract_s3_target(&contract.target)?;
 1153|       |
 1154|       |        // Revalidate bucket and key
 1155|       |        if let Err(e) = self.validate_bucket_allowlist(bucket) {
 1156|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_VERIFY, e.to_string()));
 1157|       |        }
 1158|       |        if let Err(e) = Self::validate_object_key(key) {
 1159|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(PHASE_VERIFY, e.to_string()));
 1160|       |        }
 1161|       |
 1162|       |        // If no verify_checks are provided, fail-closed.
 1163|       |        if contract.verify_checks.is_empty() {
 1164|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(
 1165|       |                PHASE_VERIFY,
 1166|       |                "no verify_checks provided and no default verification available for S3 operations. \
 1167|       |                 Provide verify_checks with S3ObjectExists or S3VersionIdMatches to confirm \
 1168|       |                 the operation had the expected effect."
 1169|       |                    .to_string(),
 1170|       |            ));
 1171|       |        }
 1172|       |
 1173|       |        // Run explicit verify_checks with live client when available
 1174|       |        for check in &contract.verify_checks {
 1175|       |            self.run_check_live(check, bucket, key, PHASE_VERIFY)
 1176|       |                .await?;
 1177|       |        }
 1178|       |
 1179|       |        Ok(VerifyReceipt {
 1180|       |            verified: true,
 1181|       |            adapter_metadata: JsonMap::new(),
 1182|       |        })
 1183|      2|    }

 1199|       |    /// Shared rollback/compensate logic for versioning-based recovery.
 1200|       |    ///
 1201|       |    /// For mutating operations (PutObject, DeleteObject, CopyObject), the recovery
 1202|       |    /// strategy is:
 1203|       |    /// 1. Read `before_version_id` from prepare metadata.
 1204|       |    /// 2. Read `after_version_id` or `delete_marker_version_id` from execute metadata.
 1205|       |    /// 3. If there is an after version, delete that specific version to restore the before version.
 1206|       |    /// 4. If there is a delete marker, delete the delete marker to restore the object.
 1207|       |    ///
 1208|       |    /// When `live: true`, the adapter attempts a live S3 delete of the captured
 1209|       |    /// after version or delete marker; if the live delete fails, `recovered` is false.
 1210|       |    #[cfg(feature = "s3-client")]
 1211|       |    async fn rollback_or_compensate(
 1212|       |        &self,
 1213|       |        contract: &RollbackContract,
 1214|       |        phase: &'static str,
 1215|       |    ) -> Result<RecoveryReceipt, AdapterError> {
 1216|       |        let (bucket, key, _version_id) = Self::extract_s3_target(&contract.target)?;
 1217|       |
 1218|       |        // Revalidate bucket and key
 1219|       |        if let Err(e) = self.validate_bucket_allowlist(bucket) {
 1220|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(phase, e.to_string()));
 1221|       |        }
 1222|       |        if let Err(e) = Self::validate_object_key(key) {
 1223|       |            return Err(Self::phase_wrap_validation(phase, e.to_string()));
 1224|       |        }
 1225|       |
 1226|       |        match contract.action_type {
 1227|       |            ActionType::S3PutObject | ActionType::S3DeleteObject | ActionType::S3CopyObject => {
 1228|       |                // Extract rollback metadata from prepare and execute phases
 1229|       |                let before_version_id = contract
 1230|       |                    .metadata
 1231|       |                    .get("before_version_id")
 1232|       |                    .and_then(|v| if v.is_null() { None } else { v.as_str() });
 1233|       |                let after_version_id = contract
 1234|       |                    .metadata
 1235|       |                    .get("after_version_id")
 1236|       |                    .and_then(|v| if v.is_null() { None } else { v.as_str() });
 1237|       |                let delete_marker_version_id = contract
 1238|       |                    .metadata
 1239|       |                    .get("delete_marker_version_id")
 1240|       |                    .and_then(|v| if v.is_null() { None } else { v.as_str() });
 1241|       |
 1242|       |                // Live rollback: delete the created version/delete marker if client available
 1243|       |                let mut recovered = false;
 1244|       |                if let Ok(client) = self.client().await {
 1245|       |                    let version_to_delete = after_version_id.or(delete_marker_version_id);
 1246|       |                    if let Some(vid) = version_to_delete {
 1247|       |                        let result = client
 1248|       |                            .delete_object()
 1249|       |                            .bucket(bucket)
 1250|       |                            .key(key)
 1251|       |                            .version_id(vid)
 1252|       |                            .send()
 1253|       |                            .await;
 1254|       |                        match result {
 1255|       |                            Ok(_) => {
 1256|       |                                recovered = true;
 1257|       |                            }
 1258|       |                            Err(e) => {
 1259|       |                                tracing::warn!("S3 rollback delete failed: {}", e);
 1260|       |                            }
 1261|       |                        }
 1262|       |                    }
 1263|       |                }
 1264|       |
 1265|       |                let mut metadata = JsonMap::new();
 1266|       |                metadata.insert(
 1267|       |                    "adapter_kind".to_string(),
 1268|       |                    serde_json::Value::String(ADAPTER_KIND.to_string()),
 1269|       |                );
 1270|       |                metadata.insert(
 1271|       |                    "phase".to_string(),
 1272|       |                    serde_json::Value::String(phase.to_string()),
 1273|       |                );
 1274|       |                metadata.insert("recovered".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(recovered));
 1275|       |                metadata.insert(
 1276|       |                    "reason".to_string(),
 1277|       |                    serde_json::Value::String(
 1278|       |                        if recovered {
 1279|       |                            "S3 rollback/compensate succeeded: deleted the created version/delete marker"
 1280|       |                                .to_string()
 1281|       |                        } else {
 1282|       |                            "S3 rollback/compensate did not delete a version; client unavailable or no after_version_id/delete_marker_version_id"
 1283|       |                                .to_string()
 1284|       |                        },
 1285|       |                    ),
 1286|       |                );
 1287|       |                metadata.insert(
 1288|       |                    "before_version_id".to_string(),
 1289|       |                    before_version_id
 1290|       |                        .map(|s| serde_json::Value::String(s.to_string()))
 1291|       |                        .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
 1292|       |                );
 1293|       |                metadata.insert(
 1294|       |                    "after_version_id".to_string(),
 1295|       |                    after_version_id
 1296|       |                        .map(|s| serde_json::Value::String(s.to_string()))
 1297|       |                        .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
 1298|       |                );
 1299|       |                metadata.insert(
 1300|       |                    "delete_marker_version_id".to_string(),
 1301|       |                    delete_marker_version_id
 1302|       |                        .map(|s| serde_json::Value::String(s.to_string()))
 1303|       |                        .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
 1304|       |                );
 1305|       |                metadata.insert(
 1306|       |                    "bucket".to_string(),
 1307|       |                    serde_json::Value::String(bucket.to_string()),
 1308|       |                );
 1309|       |                metadata.insert(
 1310|       |                    "object_key".to_string(),
 1311|       |                    serde_json::Value::String(key.to_string()),
 1312|       |                );
 1313|       |
 1314|       |                Ok(RecoveryReceipt {
 1315|       |                    recovered,
 1316|       |                    adapter_metadata: metadata,
 1317|       |                })
 1318|       |            }
 1319|       |            ActionType::S3GetObject => {
 1320|       |                // Read-only operation: nothing to rollback
 1321|       |                Ok(RecoveryReceipt {
 1322|       |                    recovered: true,
 1323|       |                    adapter_metadata: JsonMap::new(),
 1324|       |                })
 1325|       |            }
 1326|       |            _ => Err(AdapterError::Unsupported(format!(
 1327|       |                "[{}] unsupported action type for rollback/compensate: {:?}",
 1328|       |                phase, contract.action_type
 1329|       |            ))),
 1330|       |        }
 1331|       |    }
 1332|       |
