  352|    128|    async fn get_agent_lockout(&self, agent_id: &str) -> Result<Option<MfaAgentLockoutRecord>> {
  353|       |        let row = sqlx::query("SELECT * FROM mfa_agent_lockouts WHERE agent_id = ?1")
  354|       |            .bind(agent_id)
  355|       |            .fetch_optional(&self.pool)
  356|       |            .await?;
  357|       |        match row {
  358|       |            Some(row) => Ok(Some(row_to_lockout_record(&row)?)),
  359|       |            None => Ok(None),
  360|       |        }
  361|    128|    }
  362|       |
  363|       |    async fn record_agent_failed_attempt(
  364|       |        &self,
  365|       |        agent_id: &str,
  366|       |        max_attempts: u32,
  367|       |        lockout_duration_secs: u64,
  368|     35|    ) -> Result<MfaAgentLockoutRecord> {
  369|       |        let mut tx = self.pool.begin_with("BEGIN IMMEDIATE").await?;
  370|       |
  371|       |        let now = chrono::Utc::now();
  372|       |        let now_str = now.to_rfc3339();
  373|       |        let locked_until = now + chrono::Duration::seconds(lockout_duration_secs as i64);
  374|       |        let locked_until_str = locked_until.to_rfc3339();
  375|       |
  376|       |        let existing = sqlx::query("SELECT * FROM mfa_agent_lockouts WHERE agent_id = ?1")
  377|       |            .bind(agent_id)
  378|       |            .fetch_optional(&mut *tx)
  379|       |            .await?;
  380|       |
  381|       |        let (new_failed, new_locked, new_lockout_count) = if let Some(ref row) = existing {
  382|       |            let locked_until_str: Option<String> = row.try_get("locked_until")?;
  383|       |            let failed_attempts: i64 = row.try_get("failed_attempts")?;
  384|       |            let lockout_count: i64 = row.try_get("lockout_count")?;
  385|       |
  386|       |            let is_locked = match locked_until_str {
  387|       |                Some(ref s) => chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s)
  388|      2|                    .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&chrono::Utc) > now)
  389|       |                    .unwrap_or(false),
  390|       |                None => false,
  391|       |            };
  392|       |
  393|       |            if is_locked {
  394|       |                // Still locked: keep incrementing attempts and extend the lock.
  395|       |                let new_failed = failed_attempts + 1;
  396|       |                (new_failed, true, lockout_count)
  397|       |            } else if locked_until_str.is_some() {
  398|       |                // Lock expired: reset the counter to 1 so the agent is not
  399|       |                // immediately re-locked by stale attempts.
  400|       |                let new_failed = 1;
  401|       |                let new_locked = new_failed >= max_attempts as i64;
  402|       |                let new_lockout_count = if new_locked {
  403|       |                    lockout_count + 1
  404|       |                } else {
  405|       |                    lockout_count
  406|       |                };
  407|       |                (new_failed, new_locked, new_lockout_count)
  408|       |            } else {
  409|       |                // No lock: keep incrementing attempts.
  410|       |                let new_failed = failed_attempts + 1;
  411|       |                let new_locked = new_failed >= max_attempts as i64;
  412|       |                let new_lockout_count = if new_locked {
  413|       |                    lockout_count + 1
  414|       |                } else {
  415|       |                    lockout_count
  416|       |                };
  417|       |                (new_failed, new_locked, new_lockout_count)
  418|       |            }
  419|       |        } else {
  420|       |            let new_failed = 1;
  421|       |            let new_locked = new_failed >= max_attempts as i64;
  422|       |            let new_lockout_count = if new_locked { 1 } else { 0 };
  423|       |            (new_failed, new_locked, new_lockout_count)
  424|       |        };
  425|       |
  426|       |        if existing.is_some() {
  427|       |            sqlx::query(
  428|       |                "UPDATE mfa_agent_lockouts
  429|       |                 SET failed_attempts = ?1,
  430|       |                     locked_until = ?2,
  431|       |                     last_failed_at = ?3,
  432|       |                     lockout_count = ?4,
  433|       |                     updated_at = ?3
  434|       |                 WHERE agent_id = ?5",
  435|       |            )
  436|       |            .bind(new_failed)
  437|       |            .bind(if new_locked {
  438|       |                Some(locked_until_str.clone())
  439|       |            } else {
  440|       |                None::<String>
  441|       |            })
  442|       |            .bind(now_str.clone())
  443|       |            .bind(new_lockout_count)
  444|       |            .bind(agent_id)
  445|       |            .execute(&mut *tx)
  446|       |            .await?;
  447|       |        } else {
  448|       |            sqlx::query(
  449|       |                "INSERT INTO mfa_agent_lockouts (
  450|       |                    agent_id, failed_attempts, locked_until, last_failed_at, lockout_count, updated_at
  451|       |                ) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?4)",
  452|       |            )
  453|       |            .bind(agent_id)
  454|       |            .bind(new_failed)
  455|       |            .bind(if new_locked {
  456|       |                Some(locked_until_str.clone())
  457|       |            } else {
  458|       |                None::<String>
  459|       |            })
  460|       |            .bind(now_str.clone())
  461|       |            .bind(new_lockout_count)
  462|       |            .execute(&mut *tx)
  463|       |            .await?;
  464|       |        }
  465|       |
  466|       |        tx.commit().await?;
  467|       |
  468|       |        let record = self
  469|       |            .get_agent_lockout(agent_id)
  470|       |            .await?
  471|       |            .expect("agent lockout record should exist after upsert");
  472|       |        Ok(record)
  473|     35|    }
  474|       |
  475|     25|    async fn reset_agent_lockout(&self, agent_id: &str) -> Result<bool> {
  476|       |        let result = sqlx::query(
  477|       |            "UPDATE mfa_agent_lockouts
  478|       |             SET failed_attempts = 0,
  479|       |                 locked_until = NULL,
  480|       |                 last_failed_at = NULL,
  481|       |                 updated_at = ?1
  482|       |             WHERE agent_id = ?2",
  483|       |        )
  484|       |        .bind(chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339())
  485|       |        .bind(agent_id)
  486|       |        .execute(&self.pool)
  487|       |        .await?;
  488|       |        Ok(result.rows_affected() > 0)
  489|     25|    }

  745|       |    #[tokio::test]
  746|      1|    async fn test_mfa_credential_lockout_recovery_one_strike_relock() {
  747|      1|        let store = SqliteStore::connect("sqlite::memory:").await.unwrap();
  748|      1|        store.apply_embedded_migrations().await.unwrap();
  749|       |
  750|      1|        let record = MfaCredentialRecord::new("agent-1", MfaFactorType::Totp, "s", "n", "k");
  751|      1|        let repo = store.mfa_credentials();
  752|      1|        repo.insert(&record).await.unwrap();
  753|       |
  754|       |        // Lock with 1 second duration
  755|      1|        repo.record_failed_attempt(record.mfa_factor_id, 1, 1)
  756|      1|            .await
  757|      1|            .unwrap();
  758|      1|        let r = repo.get(record.mfa_factor_id).await.unwrap().unwrap();
  759|      1|        assert!(r.locked_until.is_some());
  760|      1|        assert_eq!(r.failed_attempts, 1);
  761|       |
  762|       |        // Wait for lock to expire
  763|      1|        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
  764|       |
  765|       |        // After expiry, a single failed attempt re-locks immediately because
  766|       |        // failed_attempts is still 1 (equal to max_attempts). This is the
  767|       |        // post-expiry one-strike re-lock behavior.
  768|      1|        let locked = repo
  769|      1|            .record_failed_attempt(record.mfa_factor_id, 1, 1)

  838|      1|    async fn test_agent_lockout_expired_retry_does_not_immediately_relock() {
  839|      1|        let store = SqliteStore::connect("sqlite::memory:").await.unwrap();
  840|      1|        store.apply_embedded_migrations().await.unwrap();
  841|       |
  842|      1|        let repo = store.mfa_credentials();
  843|       |
  844|       |        // Lock with max_attempts=3 and 1 second duration.
  845|      1|        for _ in 0..3 {
  846|      3|            let r = repo
  847|      3|                .record_agent_failed_attempt("agent-1", 3, 1)
  848|      3|                .await
  849|      3|                .unwrap();
  850|      3|            assert!(r.locked_until.is_some() || r.failed_attempts < 3);
                                                              ^2
  851|       |        }
  852|      1|        let r = repo.get_agent_lockout("agent-1").await.unwrap().unwrap();
  853|      1|        assert!(r.locked_until.is_some());
  854|      1|        assert_eq!(r.lockout_count, 1);
  855|      1|        assert_eq!(r.failed_attempts, 3);
  856|       |
  857|       |        // Wait for the lock to expire.
  858|      1|        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).await;
  859|       |
  860|       |        // A single new failure should NOT immediately re-lock because the
  861|       |        // counter is reset after expiry.
  862|      1|        let r = repo
  863|      1|            .record_agent_failed_attempt("agent-1", 3, 1)
  864|      1|            .await
  865|      1|            .unwrap();
  866|      1|        assert!(r.locked_until.is_none(), "expired retry should not re-lock");
  867|      1|        assert_eq!(r.failed_attempts, 1);
  868|      1|        assert_eq!(r.lockout_count, 1); // no new lock
  869|       |
  870|       |        // Two more consecutive failures while not locked should re-lock.
  871|      1|        let r = repo
  872|      1|            .record_agent_failed_attempt("agent-1", 3, 1)
  873|      1|            .await
  874|      1|            .unwrap();
  875|      1|        assert!(r.locked_until.is_none());
  876|      1|        let r = repo
  877|      1|            .record_agent_failed_attempt("agent-1", 3, 1)
  878|      1|            .await
  879|      1|            .unwrap();
  880|      1|        assert!(r.locked_until.is_some());
  881|      1|        assert_eq!(r.lockout_count, 2);
  882|      1|    }

  626|     25|    async fn health_check(&self) -> crate::Result<()> {
  627|       |        // Use SELECT 1 as a cheap probe to verify the database is reachable.
  628|       |        // This is faster than PRAGMA quick_check which scans pages.
  629|       |        let mut conn = self
  630|       |            .pool
  631|       |            .acquire()
  632|       |            .await
  633|      0|            .map_err(|e| crate::StoreError::Other(e.to_string()))?;
  634|       |        sqlx::query("SELECT 1")
  635|       |            .execute(&mut *conn)
  636|       |            .await
  637|      0|            .map_err(|e| crate::StoreError::Other(e.to_string()))?;
  638|       |        Ok(())
  639|     25|    }

crates/ferrum-store/src/sync_service.rs:
    1|       |//! Sync service helper for evaluating sync readiness from local + cached state.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This module provides the read-only `evaluate_sync_readiness_from_cache()` function
    4|       |//! that composes existing pieces into a sync readiness verdict.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! ## What This Is NOT
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! - No network calls are made; leader tip comes from the local cache only.
    9|       |//! - No transport probe execution.
   10|       |//! - No cache writes.
   11|       |//! - No session mutation.
   12|       |//!
   13|       |//! ## Fail-Closed Semantics
   14|       |//!
   15|       |//! - Any repo error during chain verification, state read, or auth check
   16|       |//!   returns `Err(SyncReadinessError)`.
   17|       |//! - `is_leader_authorized` returning `Ok(false)` (deny-by-default) produces
   18|       |//!   `PreflightFailed(PF4)`, NOT an error.
   19|       |//! - Missing cached leader tip produces `PreflightFailed(PF8)`, NOT an error.
   20|       |
   21|       |use ferrum_sync::Sync1Decision;
   22|       |use ferrum_sync::decision::TipId;
   23|       |use ferrum_sync::preflight::{
   24|       |    build_preflight_input, classify, diff_class_to_decision, run_preflight,
   25|       |};
   26|       |use ferrum_sync::transport::PreflightTransportInput;
   27|       |
   28|       |use crate::sqlite::SqliteSyncPreflightRepo;
   29|       |
   30|       |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   31|       |// Sync readiness verdict
   32|       |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   33|       |
   34|       |/// Result of evaluating sync readiness from local + cached state only.
   35|       |#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   36|       |pub enum SyncReadinessVerdict {
   37|       |    /// One or more preflight checks failed.
   38|       |    PreflightFailed {
   39|       |        failed_check: ferrum_sync::preflight::PreflightCheckCode,
   40|       |    },
   41|       |    /// All preflight checks passed.
   42|       |    Ready {
   43|       |        diff_class: ferrum_sync::preflight::DiffClass,
   44|       |        decision: Sync1Decision,
   45|       |        follower_tip: Option<TipId>,
   46|       |        leader_tip: Option<TipId>,
   47|       |    },
   48|       |}
   49|       |
   50|       |impl std::fmt::Display for SyncReadinessVerdict {
   51|      0|    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
   52|      0|        match self {
   53|      0|            SyncReadinessVerdict::PreflightFailed { failed_check } => {
   54|      0|                write!(f, "preflight failed: {}", failed_check)
   55|       |            }
   56|       |            SyncReadinessVerdict::Ready {
   57|      0|                diff_class,
   58|      0|                decision,
   59|       |                ..
   60|       |            } => {
   61|      0|                write!(f, "ready: {} -> {}", diff_class, decision)
   62|       |            }
   63|       |        }
   64|      0|    }

   84|      0|            SyncReadinessError::LeaderAuthCheckFailed { msg } => {

   90|       |
   91|       |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   92|       |// evaluate_sync_readiness_from_cache
   93|       |// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   94|       |
   95|       |/// Evaluate sync readiness using only local state and the cached leader tip.
   96|       |///
   97|       |/// This composes existing building blocks:
   98|       |/// - `SqliteSyncPreflightRepo::verify_local_chain_async()` (PF1 + PF5)
   99|       |/// - `SqliteSyncPreflightRepo::read_local_state_async()` (PF2 + PF6 + PF7)
  100|       |/// - `SqliteSyncPreflightRepo::is_leader_authorized_async()` (PF4)
  101|       |/// - `LeaderTipCache::read()` for cached leader tip (PF8)
  102|       |/// - `PreflightTransportInput::evaluate()` for PF3 + PF8
  103|       |/// - `build_preflight_input()` + `run_preflight()`
  104|       |/// - `classify()` + `diff_class_to_decision()` when preflight passes
  105|       |///
  106|       |/// ## Fail-Closed Semantics
  107|       |///
  108|       |/// - Any repo error returns `Err(SyncReadinessError)`.
  109|       |/// - `is_leader_authorized` returning `Ok(false)` produces `PreflightFailed(PF4)`.
  110|       |/// - Missing cached leader tip produces `PreflightFailed(PF8)`.
  111|       |///
  112|       |/// ## Parameters
  113|       |///
  114|       |/// - `leader_address` — The leader's address. `None` or empty causes PF3 to fail.
  115|      4|pub async fn evaluate_sync_readiness_from_cache(
  116|      4|    leader_address: Option<String>,
  117|      4|    repo: &SqliteSyncPreflightRepo,
  118|      4|) -> Result<SyncReadinessVerdict, SyncReadinessError> {
  119|       |    // Step 1: PF1 + PF5 — verify local chain integrity and ledger readability
  120|      4|    repo.verify_local_chain_async()
  121|      4|        .await
  122|      4|        .map_err(|e| SyncReadinessError::ChainVerificationFailed { msg: e.to_string() })?;
                                                                                      ^0^0          ^0^0
  123|       |    // verify_local_chain_async returns Result<(), SyncRepoError>; Ok(()) means verified
  124|      4|    let chain_verified = true;
  125|       |
  126|       |    // Step 2: PF2 + PF6 + PF7 — read local sync state flags and follower tip
  127|      4|    let local_state = repo
  128|      4|        .read_local_state_async()
  129|      4|        .await
  130|      4|        .map_err(|e| SyncReadinessError::LocalStateReadFailed { msg: e.to_string() })?;
                                                                                   ^0^0          ^0^0
  131|       |
  132|       |    // Step 3: PF4 — check leader authorization (deny-by-default on unknown leader)
  133|      4|    let leader_authorized = repo

    1|       |//! State transition validation for store entities.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This module provides pure transition helpers that enforce valid state
    4|       |//! transitions for capabilities, approvals, and executions.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! ## Execution State Transition Matrix
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! The `is_valid_execution_transition` function enforces a strict matrix at the
    9|       |//! store seam. Self-transitions are allowed only for idempotent states:
   10|       |//! Authorized, Prepared, Running, AwaitingVerification.
   11|       |//!
   12|       |//! Valid transitions (behavior-preserving for current handler sites):
   13|       |//!
   14|       |//! | From               | To (valid)                                                  |
   15|       |//! |--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
   16|       |//! | Proposed           | Authorized, Running, Canceled                               |
   17|       |//! | Authorized         | Running, Canceled, Authorized (self)                        |
   18|       |//! | Prepared           | Running, Canceled, Prepared (self)                        |
   19|       |//! | Running            | Committed, Failed, Compensated, Running (self)            |
   20|       |//! | AwaitingVerification | Committed, Failed, Compensated, AwaitingVerification (self) |
   21|       |//! | AwaitingApproval   | Canceled                                                    |
   22|       |//! | Terminal           | none                                                        |
   23|       |//!
   24|       |//! Terminal states: Committed, Compensated, RolledBack, Denied, Quarantined,
   25|       |//! Failed, Canceled.
   26|       |//!
   27|       |//! Rollback/full-execution workflow strictness (e.g., specific compensation paths)
   28|       |//! is enforced at the handler layer; this matrix is the store seam guard.
   29|       |//!
   30|       |//! ## Deferred: Rollback/Full Execution Strictness
   31|       |//!
   32|       |//! The rollback and full-execution workflow strictness (e.g., enforcing that
   33|       |//! Committed executions can only transition through specific compensation paths)
   34|       |//! is **deferred** to a future slice. This module currently enforces:
   35|       |//!   - Capability: Active → {Used, Expired, Revoked, Quarantined}; terminal states absorbing
   36|       |//!   - Approval:  Pending → {Granted, Denied, Expired}; terminal states absorbing
   37|       |//!   - Execution: strict matrix above; terminal states absorbing
   38|       |//!
   39|       |//! A future slice will add rollback-specific transition graphs and full strictness.
   40|       |

    1|       |//! Sync-1 Decision Kernel — pure, read-only decision logic for one-way fast-forward sync.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This module implements the decision table for Sync-1. It is a **pure function**
    4|       |//! with no transport, network, or mutation side effects.
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! ## Decision Table
    7|       |//!
    8|       |//! | Condition                                            | Decision                   |
    9|       |//! |------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------|
   10|       |//! | leader_tip == follower_tip                           | DONE (no sync needed)      |
   11|       |//! | leader_tip < follower_tip                            | ABORT A4 (follower ahead)  |
   12|       |//! | leader_tip > follower_tip AND hash_path valid        | SYNC (fetch N+1..M)        |
   13|       |//! | leader_tip > follower_tip AND hash_path INVALID      | ABORT A3 (C2 violation)    |
   14|       |//! | follower_tip is NONE AND leader_tip exists          | FAST_FORWARD (bootstrap)   |
   15|       |//!
   16|       |//! ## Fail-Closed Semantics
   17|       |//!
   18|       |//! Any ambiguous or unexpected input state results in an abort. The kernel never
   19|       |//! returns a "proceed" decision when it cannot confirm a safe path.
   20|       |
   21|       |use crate::error::Sync1AbortCode;
   22|       |pub use crate::transport::TipId;
   23|       |
   24|       |/// Input to the Sync-1 decision kernel.
   25|       |///
   26|       |/// All fields are explicit, caller-provided values. The kernel does not
   27|       |/// derive or fetch any of them.
   28|       |#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   29|       |pub struct DecisionInput {
   30|       |    /// The follower's current tip. `None` means the follower ledger is empty.
   31|       |    pub follower_tip: Option<TipId>,
   32|       |    /// The leader's current tip. `None` means the leader could not provide a tip,
   33|       |    /// which triggers a fail-closed abort (A7).
   34|       |    pub leader_tip: Option<TipId>,
   35|       |    /// Whether the hash-path continuity check passed between follower tip and leader tip.
   36|       |    /// Only meaningful when both tips exist and leader is ahead.
   37|       |    pub hash_path_valid: bool,
   38|       |}
   39|       |
   40|       |/// Outcome of the Sync-1 decision kernel.
   41|       |///
   42|       |/// Each variant corresponds to exactly one row in the Sync-1 decision table.
   43|       |/// `Abort` carries the specific `Sync1AbortCode` for diagnostics.
   44|       |#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   45|       |pub enum Sync1Decision {
   46|       |    /// Leader and follower are at the same tip — no sync needed.
   47|       |    Done,
   48|       |    /// Sync should proceed: fetch entries follower_tip+1 .. leader_tip.
   49|       |    Sync,
   50|       |    /// Follower has no ledger — bootstrap from genesis to leader_tip.
   51|       |    FastForward,
   52|       |    /// Unsafe to proceed — abort with the given code. Local chain unchanged.
   53|       |    Abort(Sync1AbortCode),
   54|       |}
   55|       |
   56|       |impl Sync1Decision {
   57|       |    /// Returns `true` if this decision allows progress (Done, Sync, or FastForward).
   58|      3|    pub fn is_proceed(&self) -> bool {
   59|      3|        !matches!(self, Sync1Decision::Abort(_))
                       ^2
   60|      3|    }
   61|       |
   62|       |    /// Returns `true` if this decision is an abort.
   63|      3|    pub fn is_abort(&self) -> bool {
   64|      3|        matches!(self, Sync1Decision::Abort(_))
                      ^0
   65|      3|    }
   66|       |
   67|       |    /// Returns the abort code if this is an abort decision.
   68|      6|    pub fn abort_code(&self) -> Option<Sync1AbortCode> {
   69|      6|        match self {
   70|      6|            Sync1Decision::Abort(code) => Some(*code),
   71|      0|            _ => None,
   72|       |        }
   73|      6|    }
   74|       |}
   75|       |
   76|       |impl std::fmt::Display for Sync1Decision {
   77|      4|    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
   78|      4|        match self {
   79|      1|            Sync1Decision::Done => write!(f, "DONE"),
   80|      1|            Sync1Decision::Sync => write!(f, "SYNC"),
   81|      1|            Sync1Decision::FastForward => write!(f, "FAST_FORWARD"),
   82|      1|            Sync1Decision::Abort(code) => write!(f, "ABORT({})", code),
   83|       |        }
   84|      4|    }
   85|       |}
   86|       |
   87|       |/// Evaluate the Sync-1 decision table.
   88|       |///
   89|       |/// This is a **pure function**: no side effects, no transport calls, no mutation.
   90|       |/// Given the current follower state and leader state, it returns the correct
   91|       |/// Sync-1 decision per the fail-closed decision table.
   92|       |///
   93|       |/// ## Fail-Closed Guarantees
   94|       |///
   95|       |/// - If `leader_tip` is `None`, returns `Abort(A7)` — cannot sync without a leader.
   96|       |/// - If `follower_tip` is `Some` but sequences are inconsistent (e.g., same sequence
   97|       |///   but different hashes), returns `Abort(A3)` — potential C2 violation.
   98|       |/// - Any unexpected state falls through to `Abort(A0)` — unknown/preflight failure.
   99|      8|pub fn decide(input: &DecisionInput) -> Sync1Decision {
  100|       |    // A leader tip is required for any sync decision.
  101|      8|    let leader = match &input.leader_tip {
                      ^7
  102|      7|        Some(tip) => tip,
  103|      1|        None => return Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A7),
  104|       |    };
  105|       |
  106|      7|    match &input.follower_tip {
  107|       |        None => {
  108|       |            // Follower ledger is empty — bootstrap via fast-forward.
  109|      1|            Sync1Decision::FastForward
  110|       |        }
  111|      6|        Some(follower) => {
  112|       |            // Both tips present — apply the decision table.
  113|       |
  114|       |            // Row: leader_tip == follower_tip -> DONE
  115|      6|            if leader.sequence == follower.sequence {
  116|      3|                if leader.hash == follower.hash {
  117|      2|                    return Sync1Decision::Done;
  118|       |                } else {
  119|       |                    // Same sequence, different hash — C2 violation.
  120|      1|                    return Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A3);
  121|       |                }
  122|      3|            }
  123|       |
  124|       |            // Row: leader_tip < follower_tip -> ABORT A4 (follower ahead)
  125|      3|            if leader.sequence < follower.sequence {
  126|      1|                return Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A4);
  127|      2|            }
  128|       |
  129|       |            // leader.sequence > follower.sequence — leader is ahead.
  130|      2|            if input.hash_path_valid {
  131|       |                // Row: hash_path valid -> SYNC
  132|      1|                Sync1Decision::Sync
  133|       |            } else {
  134|       |                // Row: hash_path INVALID -> ABORT A3 (C2 violation)
  135|      1|                Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A3)
  136|       |            }
  137|       |        }
  138|       |    }
  139|      8|}

  144|       |

    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This module provides a trait boundary for external event sources (e.g., MCP runtimes)
    4|       |//! that can be faked for testing, enabling sync to consume external events without
    5|       |//! real network dependencies.
    6|       |
    7|       |use async_trait::async_trait;
    8|       |use std::sync::Mutex;
    9|       |
   10|       |use crate::error::{Result, SyncError};
   11|       |use ferrum_proto::ProvenanceEvent;
   12|       |
   13|       |/// Trait for external event sources that can be polled for provenance events.
   14|       |///
   15|       |/// Implementations must be Send + Sync because the trait is used as a trait object
   16|       |/// in GatewayRuntime's bridges field, which must be Send + Sync for the runtime
   17|       |/// to be usable as axum State.
   18|       |///
   19|       |/// # Design
   20|       |///
   21|       |/// This trait uses &self methods with interior mutability to enable:
   22|       |/// - Trait objects stored in Arc<dyn ExternalEventSource> (requires &self only methods)
   23|       |/// - Safe state mutations via Mutex guards within implementations
   24|       |///
   25|       |/// This trait is designed to be "fakeable" - a simple in-memory implementation
   26|       |/// can satisfy this contract without any real network or external dependencies.
   27|       |#[async_trait]
   28|       |pub trait ExternalEventSource: Send + Sync {
   29|       |    /// Returns the unique identifier for this runtime/event source.
   30|       |    fn runtime_id(&self) -> &str;
   31|       |
   32|       |    /// Returns true if the event source is currently connected.
   33|       |    fn is_connected(&self) -> bool;
   34|       |
   35|       |    /// Attempt to connect to the external event source.
   36|       |    ///
   37|       |    /// Idempotent: returns Ok(()) if already connected.
   38|       |    async fn try_connect(&self) -> Result<()>;
   39|       |
   40|       |    /// Poll for new provenance events from the external source.
   41|       |    ///
   42|       |    /// Returns a vector of events (may be empty). Returns error if not connected.
   43|       |    async fn poll_events(&self) -> Result<Vec<ProvenanceEvent>>;
   44|       |}
   45|       |
   46|       |/// A fakeable in-memory external event source implementation for testing.
   47|       |///
   48|       |/// This implementation:
   49|       |/// - Requires NO real external runtime
   50|       |/// - Is fully deterministic and controllable via construction options
   51|       |/// - Supports pre-loading events for test scenarios
   52|       |///
   53|       |/// # Builder Pattern
   54|       |///
   55|       |/// Use [`FakeExternalEventSource::new`] to create, then chain builder methods:
   56|       |/// ```
   57|       |/// # use ferrum_sync::FakeExternalEventSource;

   61|       |#[derive(Debug)]
   62|       |pub struct FakeExternalEventSource {

   65|       |    events: Mutex<Vec<ProvenanceEvent>>,
   66|       |}

    1|       |//! Sync-2 Read-Only Preflight + Diff Classifier.
    2|       |//!
    3|       |//! This module implements the read-only preflight checks (PF1-PF8) and diff
    4|       |//! classifier. It provides:
    5|       |//!
    6|       |//! - A pure `DiffClass` classifier that maps two ledger tips to a classification
    7|       |//! - A pure `run_preflight()` function that checks PF1-PF8 preconditions
    8|       |//! - A bridging function `diff_class_to_decision()` that maps `DiffClass` to
    9|       |//!   the Sync-1 decision kernel's `Sync1Decision`
   10|       |//!
   11|       |//! ## Fail-Closed Guarantees
   12|       |//!
   13|       |//! - `classify()` returns `Unknown` on any ambiguity (never guesses)
   14|       |//! - `run_preflight()` returns `Fail` on the first failing check
   15|       |//! - `diff_class_to_decision()` maps `Unknown` to `Abort(A0)`
   16|       |//! - No network calls, no repo queries, no mutation
   17|       |
   18|       |use crate::decision::{Sync1Decision, TipId};
   19|       |use crate::error::Sync1AbortCode;

   26|       |/// Classification of the relationship between follower and leader ledger tips.
   27|       |#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
   28|       |pub enum DiffClass {
   29|       |    /// Leader and follower are at the same tip (including both None).
   30|       |    InSync,
   31|       |    /// Follower's sequence is ahead of leader's.
   32|       |    FollowerAhead,
   33|       |    /// Leader's sequence is ahead of follower's; follower has a non-empty ledger.
   34|       |    LeaderAhead,
   35|       |    /// Follower's ledger is empty and leader has entries; bootstrap required.
   36|       |    Bootstrap,
   37|       |    /// Follower and leader are at the same sequence but hashes differ.

   39|       |    /// Insufficient information to classify; fail-closed default.
   40|       |    Unknown,
   41|       |}

  201|       |

  203|      6|    if let (Some(f), Some(l)) = (follower_tip, leader_tip) {
                               ^4       ^4
  204|      4|        if f == l {
  205|      1|            return DiffClass::InSync;
  206|      3|        }
  207|      2|    }
  208|       |
  209|       |    // Follower has entries but leader does not -> follower ahead
  210|      5|    if follower_tip.is_some() && leader_tip.is_none() {
                                               ^3         ^3
  211|      0|        return DiffClass::FollowerAhead;
  212|      5|    }
  213|       |
  214|       |    // Leader has entries but follower does not -> bootstrap
  215|      5|    if follower_tip.is_none() && leader_tip.is_some() {
                                               ^2         ^2
  216|      2|        return DiffClass::Bootstrap;
  217|      3|    }
  218|       |
  219|       |    // Both have entries: compare sequences
  220|      3|    let follower = match follower_tip {
  221|      3|        Some(t) => t,
  222|      0|        None => return DiffClass::Unknown,
  223|       |    };
  224|      3|    let leader = match leader_tip {
  225|      3|        Some(t) => t,
  226|      0|        None => return DiffClass::Unknown,
  227|       |    };
  228|       |
  229|      3|    if follower.sequence > leader.sequence {
  230|      1|        return DiffClass::FollowerAhead;
  231|      2|    }
  232|       |
  233|      2|    if leader.sequence > follower.sequence {
  234|      1|        return DiffClass::LeaderAhead;
  235|      1|    }
  236|       |
  237|       |    // Same sequence: compare hashes
  238|      1|    if follower.hash == leader.hash {
  239|      0|        DiffClass::InSync
  240|       |    } else {
  241|      1|        DiffClass::Divergent
  242|       |    }
  243|      7|}

  245|       |/// Map a `DiffClass` to the Sync-1 decision kernel's `Sync1Decision`.
  246|      6|pub fn diff_class_to_decision(class: DiffClass) -> Sync1Decision {
  247|      6|    match class {
  248|      1|        DiffClass::InSync => Sync1Decision::Done,
  249|      1|        DiffClass::FollowerAhead => Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A4),
  250|      1|        DiffClass::LeaderAhead => Sync1Decision::Sync,
  251|      2|        DiffClass::Bootstrap => Sync1Decision::FastForward,
  252|      1|        DiffClass::Divergent => Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A3),
  253|      0|        DiffClass::Unknown => Sync1Decision::Abort(Sync1AbortCode::A0),
  254|       |    }
  255|      6|}

  136|       |/// This trait defines the minimal set of repo operations that Sync-2 preflight

  171|       |    /// Returns `Err` only for repo-level failures (e.g., capability store

  106|       |/// Asserts that `haystack` contains all keys/values from `needle` at the top level.
  107|       |///
  108|       |/// Panics with a descriptive message if any key is missing or the value does not match.
  109|       |///
  110|       |/// # Example
  111|       |///
  112|       |/// ```
  113|       |/// use ferrum_testkit::assert_json_contains;
  114|       |/// use serde_json::json;
  115|       |///
  116|       |/// let response = json!({"status": "ok", "count": 42});
  117|       |/// assert_json_contains(&response, &json!({"status": "ok"}));
  118|       |/// ```
  119|      3|pub fn assert_json_contains(haystack: &serde_json::Value, needle: &serde_json::Value) {
  120|      3|    let hay_obj = haystack
  121|      3|        .as_object()
  122|      3|        .expect("haystack must be a JSON object");
  123|      3|    let needle_obj = needle.as_object().expect("needle must be a JSON object");
  124|       |
  125|      3|    for (key, expected) in needle_obj {
  126|      3|        let actual = hay_obj
  127|      3|            .get(key)
  128|      3|            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing key '{}' in haystack", key));
                                             ^1
  129|      3|        assert_eq!(
